label: 180 Shutter Natural
clause: Shoot with a 180-degree shutter so strides and rain-needles read as natural cinema cadence.
still: Mid-stride freeze with brief rain-needles, honest blur only on the moving foot.

label: 45 Shutter Staccato
clause: Chop the shutter to a 45-degree angle so fists become staccato chips and splashes sit like glass beads.
still: Knuckles frozen as staccato chips, splash beads like glass, almost no smear.

label: 360 Shutter Smear
clause: Open the shutter toward a 360-degree smear so arms taffy across the plate while lamps stay readable cores.
still: Arms smeared as taffy bands, lamps as steady cores, body dragged along the path.

label: Long Exposure Still
clause: Expose for many seconds on a locked tripod so pedestrians ghost and window lamps burn as solid bricks.
still: Ghosted pedestrians stacked over empty pavement, window lamps as solid bricks.

label: Dragging Shutter Night
clause: Drag the shutter through nocturnal traffic so headlights paint ribbons and neon worms along the boulevard.
still: Headlight ribbons and neon worms on wet asphalt, one sharp figure caught by a late pop.
audio: Tire hiss and distant horns smear with the light-ribbons.

label: Real Time
clause: Play the scene in unwarped real time with a metronome gait and no speed change at all.
still: A metronome-gait still, body honest, no speed artifact in cloth or hair.

label: Theatrical Linger
clause: Let a waltz hang at a theatrical linger so skirts bloom like underwater bells around the dancers.
still: Skirt panels blooming like underwater bells, dancers frozen mid-sway.

still: Athlete floating at the peak, turf pellets hovering around the shoes.

clause: Pour a ribbon of honey at commercial beauty speed so it coils in air before the spoon.
still: Honey ribbon coiled in air before the spoon, separate droplets hanging.

label: Action Review Speed

still: Tackle frozen, grass blades and spit in a readable arc off the mouthguard.
audio: The hit stretches into a long padded thud.
